Instrument (EN): Dependent AI cognitive offloading — preliminary 4-item mode-specific measure
Scales / measured domains (EN): Dependent cognitive offloading: delegating core problem-solving/thinking to generative AI instead of active personal reasoning. SINGLE construct, NOT a subscale of Chang AI-COS-20.
Research provenance: Zhu Q, Li X, Dong Y, Chang P, Fan M, Frontiers in Psychology 17:1878629, published 2026-07-16. Three-wave longitudinal correlational survey, final matched N589 (initial 742 at T1). Author explicitly calls psychometric assessment preliminary, without retest or adjacent-construct differentiation.
